title: BATWA v2.4.6 Zero-Meter Account & Analytics Error Fix
message: Naya update live ho chuka hai! Tamam dummy accounts aur mock data mukammal khatam kar diye gaye hain. Ab app true zero-meter account ke sath register aur operate karegi.
features: Purged all mock / dummy accounts ('William Current') and fake fallback balances
Fixed DioException error on Statistics screen with clean friendly notifications
True zero-meter account: New accounts start with Rs 0.00 and zero transactions
Automatic token reset: Expired or invalid sessions cleanly route back to Welcome / Booting screen
New modern Batwa Booting screen with Sign In & Register buttons
